title: Scale selection for geometric medians on product manifolds
summary: Geometric medians on product manifolds are sensitive to the relative scaling of factor metrics because the median objective couples the factors rather than separating them. We study this scale-selection problem and first prove that naive joint minimization over location and scale is degenerate: the scale is driven to the boundary and the problem collapses to a marginal median, effectively discarding one factor.
